userStories.notes: Planning story completed. Generated 11 stories (US-64-002 through US-64-012) covering: caption healer for format discovery, negative caption caching, healer timeout configuration, orchestrator metrics dashboard, caption circuit breaker integration, healer result caching, pattern routing coverage expansion, preflight check extensibility, healing strategy presets, cross-healer coordination events, and healing session persistence. Analysis focused on user interview context about caption fetching inefficiency and broader agent system improvements.

userStories.title: Add negative caption caching to prevent repeated failed lookups
acceptanceCriteria: Extend CaptionHealer or create CaptionNegativeCache to cache 'no captions available' results
Set configurable TTL for negative cache entries (default 1 hour) in healing config
Add cache check before attempting caption fetch in CaptionHealer.fix()
Propagate structured 'no captions' status that downstream stages can handle gracefully
Add tests verifying negative cache prevents repeated failed caption attempts
Add test verifying TTL expiration allows retry after configured interval
userStories.notes: Completed. Integrated CaptionHealer with existing CaptionCache negative cache functionality. Added NoCaptionsStatus dataclass for structured status propagation. CaptionHealer.fix() now checks is_caption_unavailable() before format discovery, and stores unavailable results via store_unavailable(). Uses existing negative_cache_ttl_seconds config (default 3600s = 1 hour). Added 18 new tests covering negative cache prevention, TTL expiration, and NoCaptionsStatus serialization. Files: src/agents/healers/caption.py (extended), src/agents/healers/__init__.py (exports), tests/test_caption_healer.py (tests).

userStories.notes: Completed. Added healer_timeouts and healer_max_attempts dicts to HealingStrategy with sensible defaults (api-healer: 120s/5 attempts, disk-healer: 10s/1 attempt, etc.). Added DEFAULT_HEALER_TIMEOUT=30s fallback. Modified _try_healer() to use ThreadPoolExecutor with per-healer timeout. Added _get_healer_timeout() and _get_healer_max_attempts() helper methods. Created tests/test_healer_timeout.py with 21 tests covering: strategy config, orchestrator timeout enforcement, default fallback behavior, metrics recording on timeout. Files: src/agents/strategy.py, src/agents/orchestrator.py, tests/test_healer_timeout.py.

userStories.title: Add healing metrics dashboard with real-time statistics
acceptanceCriteria: Add get_dashboard_metrics() method to HealingOrchestrator returning structured metrics dict
Include heal success rate, average heal time, healer utilization breakdown
Include error category distribution from watcher classifications
Add format_dashboard() method for human-readable console output
Integrate dashboard output into print_report() in src/agents/orchestrator.py
Add tests verifying dashboard metrics accuracy with mock heal events
userStories.notes: Completed. Implementation includes: (1) get_dashboard_metrics() returns structured dict with success_rate, average_heal_time_ms, total_heals, successful_heals, failed_heals, healer_utilization (per-healer breakdown with attempts/success/rate/avg_time), error_categories, heals_by_stage, time_spent_healing, preflight_issues, user_escalations, rollbacks. (2) HealingMetrics enhanced with record_error_category(), get_heal_success_rate(), get_average_heal_time_ms(), get_healer_success_rate(), get_healer_average_time_ms(). (3) format_dashboard() produces human-readable console output with sections for overall stats, healer utilization breakdown, error categories (sorted by count), heals by stage, preflight issues, escalations, and rollbacks. (4) print_report() shows dashboard when total_heals > 0, otherwise shows summary. (5) Error category tracking integrated into _classify_error() for both watcher and pattern classifications. Files: src/agents/strategy.py (HealingMetrics), src/agents/orchestrator.py (dashboard methods), tests/test_healing_dashboard.py (22 tests). All 22 tests pass.

userStories.notes: Completed. CaptionCircuitBreaker already existed at src/caption/circuit_breaker.py with full circuit breaker pattern implementation. Updated defaults to match story requirements: threshold=5 (was 10), pause_seconds=60 (was 120). Integration already in place: caption_fetcher.py uses circuit breaker in error handling path (lines 3758-3955), orchestrator.py includes circuit_breaker in metrics (line 1310). Added circuit_breaker config section to config.yaml under caption_first. Updated tests to match new defaults. Files modified: src/caption/circuit_breaker.py, src/config/sections/download.py, config.yaml, tests/test_caption_circuit_breaker.py. All 54 circuit breaker tests + 26 cascade tests pass.

userStories.title: Add healer result caching for idempotent healing actions
acceptanceCriteria: Add HealerResultCache class to cache successful healing actions
Cache key based on error signature (type + message hash + stage)
Skip redundant healing attempts if identical error was recently healed
Add configurable cache TTL (default: 5 minutes)
Add cache invalidation when config changes (via config_modified flag)
Add tests verifying cache hit prevents redundant heal attempts
userStories.notes: Completed. Created HealerResultCache class in src/agents/healer_cache.py with: (1) error signature based on type + MD5 hash of message + stage, (2) configurable TTL (default 300s = 5 min), (3) config hash invalidation via set_config_hash() and invalidate_on_config_change(), (4) max_entries limit with LRU eviction. Integrated into HealingOrchestrator: cache check at start of coordinate_heal() before attempting healing, cache store after successful heal (both standard healers and LLM healer), cache invalidation when result.modified_config is True. Modified _try_healers_with_classification() to return tuple (result, healer_name) for cache storage. Added 33 tests in tests/test_healer_cache.py covering: config defaults, signature generation, store/get operations, TTL expiration, config invalidation, disabled cache behavior, max_entries enforcement, statistics, and integration test verifying cache hit prevents redundant heal. Files: src/agents/healer_cache.py (new), src/agents/orchestrator.py (modified), tests/test_healer_cache.py (new). All 33 tests pass.

userStories.title: Expand pattern routing coverage for common error categories
acceptanceCriteria: Add caption-specific patterns to PATTERN_ROUTING in src/agents/fallback.py
Include patterns for: 'no subtitles', 'caption unavailable', 'format not available' (subtitle context)
Add patterns for embedding-related errors (numpy shape mismatch, empty array)
Add patterns for LLM provider errors (gemini quota, anthropic overloaded)
Update pattern_route() tests to cover new patterns
Verify no false positive matches with existing test cases
userStories.notes: Completed. Added 14 new patterns to PATTERN_ROUTING: (1) Caption patterns: 'Requested format is not available' from user interviews. (2) Embedding patterns: shape_mismatch, shapes_not_aligned, broadcast, incompatible_shapes, empty_array, zero_length_array, numpy.*Error, embedding/vector fail/error. (3) LLM provider patterns: gemini quota/limit/exceeded, anthropic overloaded/capacity/unavailable, claude api_error/overloaded, ollama not_running/unavailable. Updated valid_categories to include 'caption', 'embedding', 'llm'. Added TestPatternRouteNewPatternsUS64008 class with 23 new tests covering all patterns plus 3 false positive prevention tests. Note: Gemini quota and Ollama connection_refused correctly route to 'api' category due to pattern priority (rate limit/connection errors are API errors). All 93 tests in test_fallback.py pass, plus 97 tests in test_agent_internals.py pass. Files: src/agents/fallback.py, tests/test_agents/test_fallback.py.
